title: The signal that appeared once
narration: In 1977, one radio signal looked so unusual that an astronomer wrote one word: Wow. It arrived near a frequency researchers considered promising for interstellar communication and lasted seventy-two seconds. Its strength rose and fell as the telescope beam crossed the source, making ordinary local interference less convincing. But later searches never verified the same signal again, and no confirmed transmission has explained it. The honest answer is not aliens. It is one strong unexplained candidate that left no repeatable proof.
